Chosen nahi, committed log success paate.
Lohha garam hone ka intezaar mat karo; usse maar kar hi garam karo.
Aise kaam karo jaise rukna nahi chahte.
Jahan ho start karo, jo hai use karo.
"Comfort mat dhoondh; growth dhoondh."
Khud par vishwas rakho! Apni abilities par yakeen rakho!
Hard work ka koi substitute nahi.
Success tab aata jab yakeen ho ki tum kar sakte.
Behtareen bano.
"Discipline ke bina talent nahi."
Failure feedback hai, defeat nahi.
Rengho, chalo, daudo—bas move karte raho.
